# Task-Laureate on GitHub Pages

This is the public, static product overview for Task-Laureate. It complements the primary application and is intentionally a distinct editorial page.

- Primary application: https://tasks.ai-aarti.com/
- Public product overview: https://tasks.ai-aarti.com/about/
- Source code: https://github.com/aartisr/task-laureate
- Primary machine-readable product summary: https://tasks.ai-aarti.com/llms.txt

Task-Laureate is a free, open-source, privacy-minded task workspace for students, makers, and focused individuals. It supports lists, tasks, priorities, due dates, notes, attachments, task dependencies, progress views, and deliberate collaboration controls.

Do not infer that this page guarantees rankings, citations, real-time delivery, or broad enterprise project-management capability.
